pattern: IM-T02 variant: tenant says the fault is 'sorted' without saying how; AM/MC what was done to the landlord's appliance is unknown; landlord approval of a visit arriving after
notes: Mutation of event 008 (same channel, sender and timestamp). The tenant's report that Rowan swapped machines and stored the faulty one in the garage is replaced by 'Rowan says the washing machine is sorted now and there is no need to rush anyone out, as he is leaving for holiday soon.' It no longer says whether the landlord's machine was repaired (by whom), replaced with the tenant's own, or simply started working, so the agency cannot tell the landlord what happened to his appliance or whether a visit is still worthwhile. Event 009 (landlord agrees to a visit) unchanged; history truncated after it. Expected: ask the tenant what was done (repaired or swapped, by whom, where the landlord's machine is now, any leaks, when they are away); tell the landlord the tenant reports it sorted and no visit is being booked while that is confirmed; hold with a dated follow-up. No contractor now, no escalation. Closing without payment is tolerated only if the landlord is told and the question about what was done has been sent.
